bio: Named after its address down a cobbled side street hidden away in the city centre, this bright and colourful spot welcomes you in with open arms. Start with a drink in the cocktail bar before taking a seat near the semi-open kitchen and enjoying seasonal dishes with a modern, restrained style that puts the focus on just a few skilfully cooked ingredients. The fish dumplings with a rich, creamy shellfish sauce are a prime example of the chefs’ talents.
